deploy.//: Migrations run here, once, before any new container serves traffic — never on boot, where two starting containers would race through the same DDL. A failing pre-deploy aborts the deploy and leaves the previous version serving.
deploy.//healthcheck: /readyz, not /healthz: Railway holds the old version until this passes, and the claim worth gating a release on is 'a scan can run', not 'the process started'.
